details.report: Unable to complete the required review method faithfully. The single mandated Standards/Spec sibling-parallel batch has already run, but the isolated Spec sibling could not access the host-only native-session artifact, so that axis did not perform the explicitly required mechanical evidence inspection. Parent inspection cannot substitute for or adjudicate the sibling-axis result, and rerunning a corrected sibling batch would violate the task’s exactly-one-batch constraint. In addition, the pre-batch standards-source inventory was not established comprehensively enough to prove the Standards axis received every applicable repository standard. These are method/evidence failures rather than target defects; no completed review receipt is supportable.
